say:1:1430215401:1.text: Oh... I haven't considered anything yet, but I plan to go to the surface and take a look.
say:1:1430215401:1.source_cn: 未来的打算，唔……这点我还没有考虑过，不过我打算先去上...
say:1:1430215401:1.male: Oh... I haven't considered anything yet, but I plan to go to the surface and take a look.
say:1:1430215401:1.female: Oh... I haven't considered anything yet, but I plan to go to the surface and take a look.

say:3:1430215402:1.text: I don't plan to go to the surface. I've lived underground my whole life and wish to continue.
say:3:1430215402:1.source_cn: 我就不去上面了，我一直在地下长大，已经习惯了这样生活。

say:4:1430215403:2.text: No matter what the future holds for us... This chance was brought to us by Indris. He is a hero among the Essail!
say:4:1430215403:2.source_cn: 不管未来怎么样……感谢因度厄，他是我们的英雄！
